fields.label: Admin Override PIN
fields.description: PIN required to override production tolerance (>4% variance) and other admin gates.

fields.label: Production Tolerance (%)
fields.description: Production net weight may differ from the input thread weight by up to this %. Beyond it, the Admin Override PIN is required.

fields.label: Inward Under-receipt Tolerance (%)
fields.description: How far SHORT of the ordered weight a receipt may fall and still count as complete. 10 means 90% of the order closes it.

fields.label: Inward Over-receipt Tolerance (%)
fields.description: How far OVER the expected weight a receipt may go before it is refused. 20 means up to 120% of the challan is accepted.

fields.label: Auto-close leftover cutting/production
fields.description: When a program takes fewer batches than the cutting could yield, auto-close the leftover if it is within the tolerance below.

fields.label: Leftover Tolerance (Kg)
fields.description: Leftover at or below this weight counts as nothing left, so the cutting/production auto-closes.

fields.label: Program View Notes
fields.description: The general notes box on the Program View screen — a shared scratchpad for the floor, not tied to any one machine or program.

fields.label: Company Address
fields.description: Printed under the brand on the challan. Left blank, the challan simply omits it — nothing is invented.

fields.label: Challan Terms
fields.description: One line per term, printed at the foot of every challan. Blank falls back to the standard Jari/bobbin terms in English and Gujarati.
